## Organizations and neighbors
who know this city
Josh BeckerCalifornia State Senator, District 13…along with local officials and neighborsSee who’s standing with us →
## Outcomes over process
City government should be measured by what actually improves in residents’ lives — not by the process it runs to get there. I bring a builder’s mindset to public service: define the outcome, find the simplest path, and deliver it. Every vote I cast on the Council will come back to one test — does this make life measurably better for Menlo Park?
The district
## District 1 — the community I’m running to serve
Belle Haven and the Bayfront, north of the freeway. I have published the research behind my platform — who lives here, how the ground was divided, what the rules allow, and the one decision still open.

# Who’s standing with us
This campaign runs on neighbors. From organizations and community leaders to families across District 1, here are some of the groups and people who believe a better quality of life for Belle Haven and the Bayfront is within reach — and who are helping get us there. Want to stand with Wonman? Add your name. Every endorsement, from a longtime resident to a first-time voter, helps show District 1 that neighbors are ready for change.
Join them. Vote Wonman Lee by Nov. 3.
Make your plan to vote
